# Webapp testing skill

This project is a C starter, so this skill serves as a template for future test automation patterns and extension points.

## Pattern

- keep tests deterministic
- test public behavior
- isolate the component under test
- validate via small, direct commands

## Note

This skill is intentionally lightweight because the current project is a minimal C application, not a full web stack.
